question.text: Which of the following statement is true?

options.text: In <math><mi mathvariant="normal">I</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>5</mn></mrow></msub></math> the hybridization of central atom is <math><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></math>

Double bond(s) in <math><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub></math> and <math><mi mathvariant="normal">X</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> , is/are occupying equatorial position(s) of their

solution.text:
A. Both SbF4- and SF4 have sea-saw structure
B. IOF3 has sp3d2 hybridisation
C. Both SOF4 and XeO3F2 have trigonal bipyramidal structure where double bond is present at equatorial position.
